description: t.0 completes while its child t.0.c1 runs in t.0.r1, and c1 already holds a pending cancel from the poll quota it inherited. Closing t.0.r1 requests a User cancel for c1, which does not strengthen that reason, so Rust's CancelTaskWaker does not fire again: c1 is dispatched once on the cancel lane, then on the ready lane after it yields (dispatches 7 and 8; fuzz gen-16-19, bd-yx6l).
